_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS instance (folio-assistant-core) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`. The same shape as the platform's own docs/wireframes/index.json, which held these two entries until 2026-10-20: a wireframe sits with the page it draws, and check:wireframes reads every instance's `<site>/wireframes/index.json` through its declaration (cat-harness-tools#281). In the platform's index these refs named a layer above it (wrong-direction move M2). `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from the platform's docs/wireframes/ so the drawings render here on their own.
